keyPoint: The Contacts page gives you the big picture. It shows who is in your CRM and helps you decide who needs attention.

actionSteps.title: Review columns
actionSteps.description: Look at what information is displayed for each contact

quizzes.question: Which of the following is NOT typically shown on the Contacts page?
quizzes.explanation: Full conversation history is found inside the individual contact record, not on the main Contacts page list view.

quizzes.question: What can you do with the search bar on the Contacts page?

options.option_text: Find specific contacts quickly using various criteria

quizzes.explanation: The search bar helps you find specific contacts quickly using various search criteria.

quizzes.question: What are Smart Lists used for on the Contacts page?

options.option_text: To narrow down and save specific contact views for later use

quizzes.explanation: Smart Lists let you save filtered views of your contacts so you can quickly access specific groups later without rebuilding filters.
